scenes.say: Six wins in one Formula Two season, and still no Formula One race seat for next year.
Nikola Tsolov is nineteen, Bulgarian and drives for Campos. He won in Monaco and twice at Silverstone.
But Racing Bulls kept Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad for twenty twenty-seven.
So Tsolov becomes reserve for both Red Bull and Racing Bulls. Simulator, Friday practice, tyre tests.
First comes the Formula Two finale. He's seven points behind Rafael Câmara, with Qatar and Abu Dhabi to go.
Last year in Formula Three these two fought for the title too. Câmara won that one.
Formula Two standings are on LapRadar.

title: Nikola Tsolov: six F2 wins, and a Red Bull reserve role for 2027
